messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High tail latency (95th > 2.5s) and growing queue for tenant `helixa` on pool `eu-central-dedicated-3`. Severity: P2. Paging eng-oncall.
Maya R.: on it. opening scheduler view now and grabbing recent request histograms.
metric-watcher-bot: recent 15m: avg tokens/request 150 -> 610; request rate +30%; per-host queue variance increasing.
Diego L.: looks like a bimodal distribution — a flood of short chat-like reqs mixed with long generation jobs. Scheduler is aggregating into large batches hitting `max_batch_tokens` ceiling, causing head-of-line waits.
Ops: Helixa Inc.: we're seeing timeouts on our webhooks and some users report slow responses. can you isolate?
Maya R.: priority is stabilizing user-facing tail. propose: 1) apply tenant-level override to reduce `max_batch_tokens` for helixa from 4096 -> 1536, 2) enable `aggressive_prefill=false` and `queue_backpressure=true` with `backpressure_threshold=250`. Canary to 1 host-group first.
Diego L.: agree. also lower `scheduler_max_latency_ms` from 350 -> 200 for helixa so scheduler favors smaller, faster batches.
Maya R.: creating override payload. command: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://controlplane/api/tenants/helixa/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"overrides":{"max_batch_tokens":1536,"aggressive_prefill":false,"queue_backpressure":true,"backpressure_threshold":250,"scheduler_max_latency_ms":200},"selector":{"pool":"eu-central-dedicated-3","host_group":"hg-5"}}'
```
deploy-bot: override request `ovr-202603151230-a1` accepted; applying to host_group hg-5.
Maya R.: applied to hg-5. monitoring link: https://obs.redwood/pool/eu-central-dedicated-3/helixa?s=5m
Diego L.: immediate telemetry: host_group hg-5 queue depth fell 60% in 90s, 95th token latency down ~42%. throughput dip ~18% for that host group.
Ops: Helixa Inc.: users report much snappier responses on our staging; production improving too. thanks.
Maya R.: rolling to remaining host_groups in pool with slightly relaxed backpressure_threshold to 300 to avoid throughput cliff. will do hg-1 then hg-2, wait 3m each.
metric-watcher-bot: after hg-1 roll: pool-wide queue median down, tail normalized. after hg-2 roll: stable. overall 99th latency reduced by ~35% and error rate fell from 1.7% -> 0.3%.
Diego L.: leaving an action: create short-lived alert `helixa_long_request_pattern` that triggers if avg tokens/request > 400 for 10m and queue depth > 300. also add a heuristic to recommend reducing `max_batch_tokens` when token-size distribution shifts > 2.5x.
Maya R.: noted. setting override TTL to 3h to allow traffic to settle, will not auto-expire sooner. override id `ovr-202603151230-a1`.
Ops: Helixa Inc.: suggest you also capture a sample of request payloads for root-cause; we saw an internal batch job that kicked off heavy summaries around the same time.
Diego L.: good catch — will request logs. also filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-3287 "tenant burst classifier + auto-suggest batching knobs".
Maya R.: handoff: I'm on-call for another 35m then handing to nightshift. leaving notes in the incident tracker and attaching grafana snapshots.
deploy-bot: override `ovr-202603151230-a1` set to expire in 3h. extend/rollback endpoints available.
Maya R.: final checklist posted: 1) keep overrides until avg tokens/request < 250 for 30m, 2) incident ticket created and assigned to Diego for postmortem analysis, 3) CS notified.
Ops: Helixa Inc.: really appreciate the quick mitigation. we'll follow up if we see recurrence. :thumbsup: (reacts: :white_check_mark: Maya R., :clap: Diego L.)
